protected_invariants: STAGE_D_PROXY_FALLBACK=NONE: THE_ODDS_API_PROXY_URL remains an explicit dedicated HTTP CONNECT endpoint; it never defaults to generic proxy variables, a workstation Clash/Mihomo endpoint, a rotating SOCKS pool or a direct route.

REMOTE_DEPLOYMENT_ONLY: concrete endpoint coordinates and all secret material remain external to Git, PR metadata and tests; the dedicated secret is root-only and its value, hash, length, prefix and suffix are never emitted.

DISTINCT_PROJECT_CONTROLLED_LISTENERS: the proxy and the TCP HMAC target are independently identifiable listeners on a documented project-controlled non-workstation host; the proxy may not CONNECT to itself.

CANONICAL_ATTESTATION_UNCHANGED: the deployed target uses the current canonical stageDStableProxy protocol helpers for fresh run_id/challenge and HMAC-SHA-256; strict 2xx and timing-safe verification stay unchanged.

ZERO_PROVIDER_CONTACT: no command resolves or contacts The Odds API, creates provider request intent, crosses the transmission boundary, consumes authorization, creates RAW evidence or charges/assumes quota.

GATE_STATE_PRESERVED: BLOCKER_2=CLOSED, BLOCKER_3=CLOSED, GATE_2=ACCEPTED, GATE_3=NOT_AUTHORIZED and STAGE_D_STARTED=NO; the spent authorization bd2d18956ae8e774fbb227bd56fa7619e2da0d4185372ae7e5108caefdc0c34a is never reused.
CANDIDATE_ONLY: any fresh Gate 3 material is a non-authorizing candidate for a future separate Owner decision; it neither activates nor consumes authorization and does not run a Stage D cycle.

EXISTING_CAPABILITIES_REVIEWED=YES; CURRENT_MILESTONE_REVIEWED=YES; VISION_ALIGNMENT_REVIEWED=YES: this narrowly closes the current Stage D transport readiness gap in the Market/Odds evidence layer and creates no North-Star-unrelated system.
forbidden_side_effects: contacting, resolving or sending a request to The Odds API; consuming provider quota; creating provider RAW data; starting Stage D or its scheduler
activating, consuming, recreating or reusing any Gate 3 authorization, including the historical spent authorization
using a workstation Clash/Mihomo proxy, a rotating SOCKS pool, REG-TITAN-40, ports 10001-10040 or direct fallback as the Stage D transport
reading, printing, logging, hashing or committing any provider key, proxy credential, preflight secret, backup credential or authorization secret
changing router or DHCP configuration, modifying unrelated shared services, reopening Blocker 2/3, touching PR #1914, training, prediction, backtest, value betting or model activation
self-merging, bypassing required CI/review, force-pushing or modifying main directly
